parameter_set.description: PyBaMM 26.10.1.1 parameter set Prada2013, exported to BPX by battinfo-records/scripts/export-pybamm-bpx.py. PyBaMM's description: Parameters for an LFP cell, from the paper.

notes: Parameter values from https://doi.org/10.1149/2.053304jes as implemented in PyBaMM's Prada2013 parameter set (PyBaMM 26.10.1.1, BSD-3-Clause), exported to BPX by battinfo-records.
Matches PyBaMM 26.10.1.1's native set within 1.01 mV RMS and 0.029% capacity (DFN discharges at 0.2C, 1C, 2C).
Cell surface area and volume: not in the PyBaMM set; derived from the electrode stack (only thermal models use them).
